svg.title: From timed trajectories to the ActionNode schedule
svg.desc: CHUGG returns per-entity trajectories; BuildActionGraph turns every non-wait motion into an ActionNode, builds an action DAG, and serialises it with integer parent indices.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: 1 · ContinuousState trajectories from Chugg::SolveSequential() (waits are not drawn)

g.text: RemoveRedundantEdges() runs after steps 2, 3 and 4 to drop implied edges; a cycle ("The graph must be a DAG.") or a failed ToActionNode fails the whole plan.
